CustomField.formula: IF(ISNULL(ClosedDate) || ISNULL(CreatedDate),NULL, IF(ClosedDate - CreatedDate >= 1.0, TEXT(FLOOR(ClosedDate - CreatedDate)) & " Dia" & IF(FLOOR(ClosedDate - CreatedDate) > 1, "s","") & IF(MOD(FLOOR((ClosedDate - CreatedDate) * 1440),1440) > 0, ", ",""), "") & IF(MOD(FLOOR((ClosedDate - CreatedDate) * 24),24) >= 1.0, TEXT(MOD(FLOOR((ClosedDate - CreatedDate)*24),24)) & " Hora" & IF(FLOOR((ClosedDate - CreatedDate)*24) > 1, "s","") & IF(MOD(FLOOR((ClosedDate - CreatedDate) * 1440),60) > 0, ", ",""), "") & IF(MOD(FLOOR((ClosedDate - CreatedDate)*1440),60) > 0, TEXT(MOD(FLOOR((ClosedDate - CreatedDate)*1440+1),60)) & " Minuto" & IF(FLOOR((ClosedDate - CreatedDate)*1440) > 1, "s",""), "") )
CustomField.label: Tempo Total
